title.t: A newer instruction moves a lead to a different sequence

when.t: A lead on one sequence is reassigned to another by a newer instruction.

steps.t: The newest instruction wins: the old sequence is closed and the change is logged as "sequence reassigned".
The new sequence's text goes to Compliance; once approved, its touches go out (only inside contact hours).
The weekly re-score names no sequence; it keeps the lead on the sequence it is on (fixed 2026-10-27; it used to move the lead back to the default sequence and restart it).

never.t: Run the old sequence alongside the new one.

you_see.t: The reassignment in the client's history.

test.t: Two sequences are signed (default and "spring buyers"). A warm lead starts on the default; the next day it is reassigned to "spring buyers"; the daily run runs then and a week later. The spring touch goes out once; the default day-7 touch does not. Stand-in: a reassignment does not arise from intake, so the test sends it as Agent 02.
